messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticing a short spike of 5xxs for model redwood-gen-v1 on the EU route around 11:14 UTC. Anyone have the canonical saved search for that route?

maya: I saw it too, thanks for flagging. Quick check — is this across all orgs or specific to acme corp?

alex: Looks concentrated on org:acme from the first pass. Small burst ~11:14–11:18, roughly 120 requests with http_status 500/502.

kai: Use the logsearch query I usually share:
```
org_id:"acme" AND model:"redwood-gen-v1" AND route:"/api/v1/generate" AND region:"eu-west-1" AND http_status:[500 TO 599] | sort @timestamp desc
```
That should show the recent 5xxs.

lucy: Adding a KV-cache hitrate filter helped us spot causal patterns before:
```
... AND meta.kv_cache_hitrate:<0.5
```
If a lot of requests have low kv cache hitrate it explains token regen & backend fallback.

alex: Nice — where do I save that as a shared preset? I can't find the saved searches in the EU space.

maya: In Logsearch UI: Dashboards -> Saved searches -> New saved search. Name it: "ops/eu-gen-5xx-acme". Set refresh to 1m and scope to org=acme. Then click Share -> team:eng-sre.

kai: If you prefer the quick CLI snippet for creating a saved view (API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://logs.redwood.example/api/saved_searches \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $LOGS_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"name":"ops/eu-gen-5xx-acme","query":"org_id:\"acme\" AND model:\"redwood-gen-v1\" AND route:\"/api/v1/generate\" AND region:\"eu-west-1\" AND http_status:[500 TO 599]","refresh":"60s"}'
```
Adjust endpoint/headers for staging/prod.

maya: Also link the Grafana panel (traces+latency) so on-call can correlate: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/latency/eu-gen-overview?orgId=1&var-model=redwood-gen-v1

lucy: For alert tuning, if it's a short burst we probably want to avoid noise. Recommending alert rule: pro-rate threshold over 5m window, e.g. alert if 5xx rate > 1% AND count >= 50 in 5m. Otherwise we get paging for tiny blips.

alex: Good call. Can someone create a saved alert draft? I can approve.

kai: I'll drop a draft in the alerts repo and ping you. Quick snippet for the rule body:
```yaml
name: eu-gen-5xx-spike
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{model="redwood-gen-v1",route="/api/v1/generate",region="eu-west-1",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{model="redwood-gen-v1",route="/api/v1/generate",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) > 0.01
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "EU gen 5xx rate >1% (acme focus)"
```
I'll set a count condition separate in the alerting UI.

sre-bot: Automatically attached trace links for 5 examples: https://traces.redwood.example/trace/abc123, https://traces.redwood.example/trace/def456

maya: Thanks! One more thing — if you save the logsearch as a team preset, please pin it to the eng-sre channel so on-call finds it fast.

alex: Will do. Creating saved search now and will post link here when done. :thumbsup:

lucy: Optional follow-up: include a quick note in the saved search description to check kv_cache_hitrate <0.5 and to look for fallback to cpu-inference nodes — we've seen a pattern where bursty kv misses cause overload.

alex: Saved and pinned: https://logs.redwood.example/saved_searches/ops/eu-gen-5xx-acme — pinned in #eng-sre. Thanks all.

kai: Nice, I'll put the alert PR up in 10m.

alex: Closing out here but will re-open if we see recurrences. Thanks team. :rocket:
